abstract: Human choriocarcinoma cells in vitro (ENAMI-1) were exposed to various concentrations of MTX (10(-8)M, 10(-7)M, 10(-6)M, 10(-4)M) for 48 hr, and after removal of MTX, cells were harvested and measured by FCM every 24 hr for 96 hr. Although the growth of cells were inhibited in MTX more than 10(-7)M in concentration, hCG-beta levels were elevated markedly. It was showed that hCG positive cells were accumulated in G1-phase by flow cytometric two color analysis with monoclonal antibody. In the presence of MTX more than 10(-7)M in concentration, the cells were accumulated in S-phase. After removal of 10(-7)M MTX, S-phase cells migrated toward G2 + M phase on the other hand in the presence of MTX more than 10(-6) M in concentration cells stopped moving to G2 + M phase. Immunoperoxidase with monoclonal antibodies against BrdU and hCG-beta has got the same phenomena resulted by FCM. It was confirmed that hCG was an useful marker for choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株ENAMI-1を、10^-8、10^-7、10^-6、10^-4 MのMTXでそれぞれ48時間曝露した。MTX除去後、24時間ごとに96時間まで細胞を採取し、FCMで測定した。MTXが10^-7 M以上の濃度では細胞増殖は抑制されたが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)-βの量は著明に上昇した。モノクローナル抗体を用いた2色フローサイトメトリー解析により、hCG陽性細胞はG1期に蓄積することが示された。10^-7 M以上のMTX存在下では、細胞はS期に蓄積した。10^-7 M MTXを除去した後、S期の細胞はG2+M期へと移行したが、10^-6 M以上のMTX存在下では、細胞はG2+M期への移行が停止した。BrdUおよびhCG-βに対するモノクローナル抗体を用いた免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色でも、FCMと同様の現象が確認された。hCGが絨毛癌の有用なマーカーであることが確認された。
